description: Engineer's pre_test_requested envelope was wrapped in a Markdown ```json fence (leading/trailing fence markers), violating engineer.md's Structured Response Contract ('Exactly one raw JSON object per turn, no fence, no prose'). Text does not parse as strict JSON as received. Independently confirmed via git status/diff that the Engineer had already performed real, legitimate, in-scope Step 6 TDD work (added test_explain_includes_overall_risk_band and updated 3 existing calls to explain() in demo-repo/tests/unit/test_explanations.py only -- no production source changed, no out-of-scope or Protected Path file touched) before this malformed envelope was returned. This is the same failure class PROJECT_SPEC.md documents for the Architect (run-20260803-riskband-001), now also observed on the Engineer's staged protocol. No repair protocol for this failure mode is authorized for the Engineer/staged phases in work/SKILL.md (the documented transport-repair mechanism is explicitly scoped to the Architect's single-shot Research phase); by analogy to that mechanism and to engineer.md's own rejected_reply pattern (reject malformed reply, request unchanged re-emission, cap attempts), one transport-only correction request is being sent to this same agent id before considering the phase blocked.

Engineer's pre_test_requested named the command 'pytest tests/unit/test_explanations.py -v'. engineer.md gives the Engineer no information about test-runner's strict positional grammar (exactly 'python -m pytest <args>', enforced at .claude/skills/test-runner/scripts/run_command.py's validate_grammar). Submitted verbatim (unmodified) to the real test-runner Skill per the requirement to execute exactly what the Engineer requested; the wrapper returned command_rejected (grammar_no_match: executable 'pytest' is not accepted). Per test-runner/SKILL.md's explicit 'Escalation on command_rejected' instruction ('Halt the staged protocol for this task ... mark the task blocked at the orchestration layer. Never relax validation live to work around a rejection.'), the command was not silently corrected/resubmitted, and the Implementation phase is blocked here. This is a genuine, newly-discovered cross-agent contract gap: engineer.md does not document test-runner's exact command grammar requirement to the Engineer, so a live Engineer naturally requests conventional pytest CLI syntax, which the wrapper always rejects. Independently confirmed via git status/diff before this rejection that only the in-scope test file demo-repo/tests/unit/test_explanations.py was modified (real TDD Step 6 work, test_explain_includes_overall_risk_band added plus 3 existing calls updated to pass a Band argument); no production source file was changed.
